title: Hammam Workshop Master the Art of Purification
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Immerse in the sacred tradition of Hammam with an exclusive all-day workshop designed for just four participants. Guided by Moroccan-trained therapists, this intimate experience kicks off with a welcome breakfast and an insightful overview of Hammam's rich history. After a light snack you'll dive into hands-on training, mastering techniques like body exfoliation and steam therapy. The day concludes with a live practice session, where you’ll receive personalized feedback and complete your practical hours for certification. Walk away not only with a revitalized skincare ritual but also with the cultural wisdom to carry this powerful tradition forward.
